positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Technical Lead on the global Apple Maps production deployment and infrastructure tools. Mission-critical tools and processes integral to Apple Maps.
- Engineering cloud agnostic Kubernetes solutions for fully automated Git-Ops-driven production deployments.
- Extensive experience with full-stack Ruby on Rails development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed tools used for automation & management of the entire Maps infrastructure - Supporting all production deployments to bare metal, VMs, and containerized infrastructure offerings.
- Streamlined processes and tools for improved reliability & scalability of Maps infrastructure to match the rapid pace of Apple Maps’ growth and supporting next generation maps.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Maps
positions.description: - Created application log processing engine to detect root causes of problems by correlating historic log patterns during similar error events.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - iCloud
positions.description:
- Developed advanced Python tools to bulk create photos with customized EXIF metadata information
for simulation and testing of iCloud Photos Uploading & Moments generation algorithms.
- Actively contributed to iCloud Photos, iCloud Drive, and iCloud Web products.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Media Platform
positions.description:
- Lead engineer for new patented (US 10,142,471) Real-Time Voice Analysis (Voiceprint Carrier Message Detection) feature in C++ for distinguishing human voices, carrier messages, and voicemail greetings in mass outgoing calls; currently in production.
- Created AAC transcoder to allow high-compression call recordings, achieving over 2x space efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Genesys Voice Platform
positions.description:
- Designed and prototyped Real-Time Voice Analysis feature in C++, later worked on productizing the feature for release.
- Improved H.264 video call compatibility between Genesys Voice Platform and Polycom VOIP devices - solved problems causing blips and artifacts found in during calls.
- Rewrote SRTP implementation for Media Server supplemented with appropriate unit and regression testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer - de Souza Institute
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented from scratch a mobile responsive course enrolment web app in CakePHP and jQuery.
- Created Shell & PHP cron jobs for syncing user pictures across multiple sites and databases.
- Enhanced existing CakePHP codebase for improved performance, reliability, & security.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- #1 secondary level studying-platform in Canada.
- Built and maintained entire website and iOS app.
- Maintained website for 13 years until its retirement in 2022.

patents.title: System and method for call progress detection
patents.description: A contact center includes an outbound server to make a call to a callee and a media device. The media device receives an audio signal based on the call, to determine a Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient for the received audio signal, and to match the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient for the audio signal to a Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient for a pre-recorded carrier message. The media device can determine a content of the audio signal based on the match.
